summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting daily share buybacks executed through Goldman Sachs International on the London Stock Exchange from April 17-30, 2026. The company purchased small lots (3,828 to 20,000 shares per day) at prices ranging from $140.75 to $147.90 per share, with all shares intended for cancellation. The buybacks were authorized at the May 2025 AGM and instructed on February 17, 2026. While share repurchases return capital, they are routine open-market transactions, not a special-situation tender or capital return event.
